subtitle: Lesson 23 · Data Architecture Across Hybrid and Multi-Cloud

code:
data residency:    in which physical country/region
                    is this data stored?

data sovereignty:  whose laws govern it, and which
                    legal process can compel access --
                    regardless of where it physically sits
caption: A dataset can satisfy residency in Germany and still raise sovereignty concerns under US law.

code:
GDPR: EU personal data restricted from leaving
      the EU/EEA without adequacy decisions,
      Standard Contractual Clauses, or binding
      corporate rules

Schrems II (2020): invalidated EU-US Privacy Shield --
      US surveillance law reached EU data even when
      physically stored inside the EU
caption: Sovereignty is separate from residency: US legal reach applied even to EU-stored data.
